svg.title: How often StrictMath and glibc differ
svg.desc: Inputs on which StrictMath and glibc 2.43 give different doubles: exp(x) 19,720, pow(2.0, x/700) 19,627, ln(|x|) 4,047, expm1(x/100) 139, of 200,000.
